ilomilo-nx rc1 (2026-11-25): notes for testing on the console
================================================================

What this NRO is
----------------
- The distributable build (tools/ilomilo_build_switch_release.bat): no game shader inside (deko3d_glsl.bin beside it,
  made by the web installer from your files), the machine copies in place (136 functions from the PC and Ryujinx
  profiles), no guard forms. NOT built with PGO or LTO: those wait for your word (the base's order of work).
- Built from the commit named by source_<commit>.tgz; ilomilo-nx.elf is its unstripped ELF.

What was tested, and how (no console was used)
----------------------------------------------
- PC (Vulkan): boots, menus, the story intro and the first level played by an input script at 60 fps; the machine
  copies checked against the generated code on every call (tools/run_pc_verify.ps1, verify2): 133 of 133 reached,
  137 million calls compared, 0 differences.
- The full game, not the trial: license_mask = 1 is built into the NRO and set in every toml here; the release NRO
  with only the player's default ilomilo.toml showed the full game's menus (Ryujinx, emu27).
- Ryujinx (the everyday NRO with the same code): logo, title, menus, loading, the first level at 56-60 fps (an
  emulator's figure, not the console's). The emulator's picture fault (coloured wedges in the depth-of-field passes)
  is fixed (ilomilo_renut_gs_no_clip); on the console those draws already had their clip slot off.
- The smaller files the installer makes: the Opus sound banks (.xmop, .opcm) load and play in Ryujinx (trial mode,
  every bank). The upsell movie's H.265 hook is built but untested: the movie plays only in the trial's buy screen,
  and the full game (this build) never shows it.

Please check on the console
---------------------------
1. The picture: the title screen's backdrop and the levels' pale sky whole (no coloured wedges or strips).
2. The sound: music, menu sounds and the narrator; anything that sounds wrong (the music is Opus at 128 kbit/s).
3. Speed: configs/renut.toml writes logs/renut_001.log; its 10 s lines give the frame rate and the render thread.

A console profile (what the hand-written natives wait for)
----------------------------------------------------------
Copy configs/renut_profile.toml over ilomilo.toml (or add `switch_profile_stacks = true` to ilomilo.toml), play the
slow scene for a few minutes, and bring back logs/rex/rex_profile.log with the name of the scene and the time. It is
read with this package's ilomilo-nx.elf (a profile read with another build's ELF is wrong without looking wrong).

Your decisions
--------------
- The music at 96 / 48 kbit/s instead of 128 / 64 would save about 11 MB more (it changes what is heard).
- PGO + LTO for the Switch build, when you say so.
